project_name: AegisGate — Moomoo x Qoder AI Trading Agent Control Plane

facts.claim: AegisGate enforces 11 deterministic pre-trade competition risk rules (R01-R11) in 0.0066ms per evaluation and reconciles all 8 AA Trading Desk Playbook §08 policy conflicts
Across 1,386 real Yahoo Finance daily bars, Wilder RSI prevented 235 false 30/70 threshold flips and up to 29.22 RSI points of Cutler simple-mean divergence
In a 190-day out-of-sample rolling test on 6 US stocks, AegisGate reduced Maximum Drawdown from 27.22% (Ungated Cutler baseline) to 7.97% while blocking 275 high-risk entries
Packaged and validated 12 Qoder Cloud Agents (QCA) Skill .zip archives (11 official Moomoo skills + 1 custom AegisGate R01-R11 Auditor skill) plus 4-Thread Coordinator & 3 Forward Mode schedules
Verified 36/36 real-browser Playwright Firefox QA scenarios across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) on both deployed and local builds
Multi-year historical options chain backtesting via Moomoo MCP
